content: If you are administering this medication at home, ensure you have been thoroughly instructed by your healthcare professional on its preparation and proper usage. Before using the medication, visually inspect the product for any particles or discoloration. If either is present, do not use the liquid. Headaches may occur as a side effect of this medication. It is important to understand that your doctor has prescribed this medication because they have determined that the benefits to you outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. However, this is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. If you are in the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Similarly, if you are in Canada, consult your doctor for guidance on side effects. Before using milrinone, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly necessary. It is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Some products may contain ingredients that could exacerbate your heart failure. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. While using this medication, it is essential to undergo regular laboratory and/or medical tests, such as monitoring blood pressure, heart rate and rhythm, kidney function, and blood mineral levels. Ensure you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. This medication is intended to be administered continuously as an infusion. If you miss a dose, consult your healthcare provider for instructions. For storage, refer to the product instructions and consult your pharmacist for specific details. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is important to note that this document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs.
